title: Google Sheets from the MCP server
items: add_destination and update_destination take Google Sheets destinations: format sheets with the spreadsheet and its columns, so an agent sets one up from start to finish without the dashboard or the SDK
create_spreadsheet can write the header row into a spreadsheet chosen with pick_spreadsheet
Remote MCP clients connected to an address with tool settings, such as /mcp?tools=all, get metadata that names that address and a token request that accepts it

In the destinations API, moving a Google Sheets destination or a file drop to a format without a config needs a url (and between the two, the new config) and clears its spreadsheet or server settings, a drop's password included; a config is refused on any other format

An endpoint's forwarding and notification fields describe its primary destination (the one holding the forwarding role, else the first other than Notifications that sends to a URL): Google Sheets destinations and file drops are never it, so changing those fields or turning forwarding off leaves them as they are
